mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'RUN' THEN overlap_sec ELSE 0 END), 0) AS run_time_sec, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'IDLE' THEN overlap_sec ELSE 0 END), 0) AS idle_time_sec, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'STOP' THEN overlap_sec ELSE 0 END), 0) AS stop_time_sec, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ALARM' THEN overlap_sec ELSE 0 END), 0) AS alarm_time_sec FROM ( SELECT status, TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, GREATEST(start_time, #{from}), LEAST(IFNULL(end_time, #{to}), #{to}) ) AS overlap_sec FROM equipment_status_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND start_time < #{to} AND IFNULL(end_time, #{to}) > #{from} ) t

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'RUN' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(s.start_time, #{from}), LEAST(IFNULL(s.end_time, #{to}), #{to})) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS run_time_sec, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'IDLE' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(s.start_time, #{from}), LEAST(IFNULL(s.end_time, #{to}), #{to})) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS idle_time_sec, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'STOP' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(s.start_time, #{from}), LEAST(IFNULL(s.end_time, #{to}), #{to})) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS stop_time_sec, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ALARM' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(s.start_time, #{from}), LEAST(IFNULL(s.end_time, #{to}), #{to})) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS alarm_time_sec FROM equipment_status_log s JOIN equipment e ON s.equipment_id = e.equipment_id WHERE e.line_no = #{lineNo} AND s.start_time < #{to} AND IFNULL(s.end_time, #{to}) > #{from}
SELECT ideal_cycle_time_sec FROM line_config WHERE line_no = #{lineNo}
SELECT line_no FROM line_config ORDER BY line_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO line_summary ( line_no, summary_start_time, summary_end_time, planned_time_sec, run_time_sec, idle_time_sec, stop_time_sec, alarm_time_sec, total_count, good_count, bad_count, availability, performance, quality, oee, created_at ) VALUES ( #{lineNo}, #{summaryStartTime}, #{summaryEndTime}, #{plannedTimeSec}, #{runTimeSec}, #{idleTimeSec}, #{stopTimeSec}, #{alarmTimeSec}, #{totalCount}, #{goodCount}, #{badCount}, #{availability}, #{performance}, #{quality}, #{oee}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment_status_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND status = 'ALARM' AND start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(duration_sec), 0) FROM equipment_status_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND status = 'RUN' AND start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(duration_sec), 0) FROM equipment_status_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND status = 'ALARM' AND start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

SELECT ( IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN end_time IS NOT NULL THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN end_time IS NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_time, NOW()) ELSE 0 END), 0) ) / 3600.0 FROM equipment_status_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND status = 'RUN'
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(duration_sec), 0) / 3600.0 / 7.0 FROM equipment_status_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND status = 'RUN' AND start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
SELECT status FROM equipment_status_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)

SELECT alarm_id AS alarmId, equipment_id AS equipmentId, DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS timestamp, alarm_type AS alarmType, alarm_text AS alarmText, alarm_memo AS alarmMemo, alarm_status AS alarmStatus FROM alarm_log ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.equipment_id, e.equipment_name, e.line_no, e.zone, e.health_score, COALESCE(ls.status, 'UNKNOWN') AS current_status, COALESCE(ac.active_alarm_count, 0) AS active_alarm_count FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN ( SELECT esl.equipment_id, esl.status FROM equipment_status_log esl INNER JOIN ( SELECT equipment_id, MAX(start_time) AS max_start_time FROM equipment_status_log GROUP BY equipment_id ) lm ON esl.equipment_id = lm.equipment_id AND esl.start_time = lm.max_start_time ) ls ON e.equipment_id = ls.equipment_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT equipment_id, COUNT(*) AS active_alarm_count FROM alarm_log WHERE alarm_status != 'RESOLVED' GROUP BY equipment_id ) ac ON e.equipment_id = ac.equipment_id ORDER BY e.equipment_id

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ls.status = 'RUN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RUN, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ls.status = 'IDLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS IDLE, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ls.status = 'STOP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS STOP, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ls.status = 'ALARM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ALARM, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ls.status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS UNKNOWN FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN ( SELECT esl.equipment_id, esl.status FROM equipment_status_log esl INNER JOIN ( SELECT equipment_id, MAX(start_time) AS max_start_time FROM equipment_status_log GROUP BY equipment_id ) lm ON esl.equipment_id = lm.equipment_id AND esl.start_time = lm.max_start_time ) ls ON e.equipment_id = ls.equipment_id WHERE e.line_no = #{lineNo}
SELECT AVG(health_score) FROM equipment WHERE line_no = #{lineNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_log al INNER JOIN equipment e ON al.equipment_id = e.equipment_id WHERE e.line_no = #{lineNo} AND al.alarm_status != 'RESOLVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_summary ( equipment_id, summary_start_time, summary_end_time, run_time_sec, idle_time_sec, stop_time_sec, alarm_time_sec, availability, performance, quality, oee, mttf_sec, mtbf_sec, mttr_sec, health_score, remaining_life, replacement_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{equipmentId}, #{summaryStartTime}, #{summaryEndTime}, #{runTimeSec}, #{idleTimeSec}, #{stopTimeSec}, #{alarmTimeSec}, #{availability}, #{performance}, #{quality}, #{oee}, #{mttfSec}, #{mtbfSec}, #{mttrSec}, #{healthScore}, #{remainingLife}, #{replacementDate}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN motor_current_a > 8.0 OR vacuum_pressure_kpa > -40 OR position_error_mm > 5.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abnormalCount FROM panel_feeder_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN clamp_pressure_bar < 4.0 OR pneumatic_pressure_bar < 4.5 OR clamp_position_mm > 5.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abnormalCount FROM body_jig_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN axis_temp_max_c > 80.0 OR tool_offset_error_mm > 5.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abnormalCount FROM robot_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (status = 'RUN' AND weld_current_dc < 4.0) OR weld_current_dc > 15.0 OR weld_voltage_ac < 170 OR weld_voltage_ac > 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abnormalCount FROM spot_welder_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN dispense_pressure_bar > 8.0 OR sealer_temperature_c > 65.0 OR (status = 'RUN' AND flow_rate_ml_s < 6.0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abnormalCount FROM sealer_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN motor_temperature_c > 75.0 OR motor_current_a > 8.0 OR (status = 'RUN' AND moving_speed_m_s < 0.2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abnormalCount FROM conveyor_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
